maria (People Ops): Exported evals from the ATS for last week's onsite cohort and half of the interviewer roles are blank in the CSV. Anyone else seeing this?

 darshan (Recruiting Ops): yup. Missing values in the `interviewer_role` column for panel ids starting with PNL-. Looks like the mapping got dropped during nightly sync.

 ats-sync-bot: Sync job completed: ats-export-2189990000 -> s3://redwood-exports/2026-03-22/complete. Records: 1248, errors: 3

 taylor (Hiring Manager): This is routing scorecards to the default reviewer and causing blind reviewers for some roles. We had 5 interviews yesterday — need a hotfix.

 sam (Sourcer): Workaround idea: import CSV into Sheets and fill 'interviewer_role' for those 5 rows, then re-run evalform ingestion. Safe?

 darshan (Recruiting Ops): We can patch ingestion to fallback to `role_from_panel` when `interviewer_role` is empty. I'll open a bug and a short migration script.

 maria (People Ops): Please loop in interviewer training leads so they know who's moderator vs tech lead. Assigning to @darshan. Is this related to last week's ATS field rename?

 darshan (Recruiting Ops): Yes — ATS renamed `panel_member_type` -> `interviewer_role` in the new schema but our CSV parser still looks for the old name. Local fix: update mapping in parsers/ats_csv_mapper.py

 ```python
 # quick local patch
 field_map = {
   'panel_member_type': 'interviewer_role',
   'interviewer_name': 'name',
 }
 # allow fallback
 row['interviewer_role'] = row.get('interviewer_role') or row.get('panel_member_type')
 ```

 maria (People Ops): Can you push the patch to staging and run the normal smoke tests? Avoid doubling notifications to candidates.

 darshan (Recruiting Ops): Plan: 1) parser update 2) re-import yesterday's export 3) alert smoke test 4) prod deploy by EOD if green. Creating ticket RECR-4123.

 taylor (Hiring Manager): Thanks. Also please tag @lina-training so facilitation lists are updated.

 sam (Sourcer): :thumbsup: I'll manually fix the 5 rows now and notify candidates if anything changes.

 ats-sync-bot: Deployment scheduled by darshan at 2026-03-22T18:45Z. Watch logs: https://logs.redwood/integrations/RECR-4123

 darshan (Recruiting Ops): Staging import succeeded, roles populated. No duplicate notifications in smoke runs. Deploying to prod in 30m.

 maria (People Ops): After deploy please re-import last 48h of exports and confirm with @lina-training and @taylor.

 darshan (Recruiting Ops): Done. Re-import finished — 12 previously blank rows filled. Pushed note to #interviewer-training. Closing thread once prod deploy completes.
